candidate_relations.reason: The EM-type rash can mimic a viral exanthem but fever plus conjunctivitis, strawberry tongue, and palmar erythema fulfill Kawasaki disease.
Abdominal ultrasound was normal; appendicitis was the incorrect initial surgical impression.
Fifth disease does not produce this full mucocutaneous Kawasaki set.
Stevens-Johnson syndrome is a related severe mucocutaneous differential incompatible with classic Kawasaki features without severe mucosal necrosis.
Systemic JIA is a related systemic inflammatory disease of childhood but is not Kawasaki disease.

case_quality_flags: No candidate names Kawasaki disease despite classic mucocutaneous criteria and negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR
